verses.original: Ὅθεν ἅγιοι ἀδελφοὶ μέτοχοι ἐπουρανίου κλήσεως κατανοήσατε Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ἀπόστολον καὶ Ἀρχιερέα ἡμῶν τῆς ὁμολογίας
verses.transliteration: Hothen hagioi adelphoi metochoi epouraniou klēseōs katanoēsate Iēsoun ton Apostolon kai Archierea hēmōn tēs homologias
verses.literal: Therefore holy brothers who share in [the] heavenly calling set your focus on Jesus the apostle and high priest whom we - confess

verses.original: ὄντα πιστὸν τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν ὡς Μωϋσῆς καὶ ἐν ὅλῳ αὐτοῦ τῷ οἴκῳ
verses.transliteration: onta piston tō poiēsanti auton hōs Mōusēs kai en holō autou tō oikō
verses.literal: He was faithful to the [One who] appointed Him just as Moses [was faithful] in all [God’s] - house

verses.original: γὰρ οὗτος ἠξίωται Πλείονος δόξης παρὰ Μωϋσῆν καθ’ ὅσον ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν ἔχει πλείονα τιμὴν τοῦ οἴκου
verses.transliteration: gar houtos ēxiōtai Pleionos doxēs para Mōusēn kath’ hoson ho kataskeuasas auton echei pleiona timēn tou oikou
verses.literal: For [Jesus] has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses just as the builder [of a house] has greater honor than the house [itself]

verses.original: γὰρ πᾶς οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος δὲ Θεός ὁ κατασκευάσας πάντα
verses.transliteration: gar pas oikos kataskeuazetai hypo tinos de Theos ho kataskeuasas panta
verses.literal: And every house is built by someone but God [is] the builder of everything

verses.original: Καὶ μὲν Μωϋσῆς πιστὸς ὡς θεράπων ἐν ὅλῳ αὐτοῦ τῷ οἴκῳ εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων
verses.transliteration: Kai men Mōusēs pistos hōs therapōn en holō autou tō oikō eis martyrion tōn lalēthēsomenōn
verses.literal: Now . . . Moses [was] faithful as a servant in all [God’s] - house vvv testifying to what would be spoken later

verses.original: δὲ Χριστὸς ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν οἶκον ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν οὗ οἶκός ἐὰν κατάσχωμεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ ἐλπίδος τῆς καύχημα
verses.transliteration: de Christos hōs huios epi autou ton oikon hēmeis esmen hou oikos ean kataschōmen tēn parrēsian kai to elpidos tēs kauchēma
verses.literal: But Christ [is faithful] as [the] Son over [God’s] - house [And] we are [His] house if we hold firmly to [our] confidence and the hope [of which] we boast

verses.original: Διό καθὼς τὸ τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα λέγει Σήμερον ἐὰν ἀκούσητε αὐτοῦ τῆς φωνῆς
verses.transliteration: Dio kathōs to to Hagion Pneuma legei Sēmeron ean akousēte autou tēs phōnēs
verses.literal: Therefore as the - Holy Spirit says Today if you hear His - voice

verses.original: μὴ σκληρύνητε ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: mē sklērynēte hymōn tas kardias hōs en tō parapikrasmō kata tēn hēmeran tou peirasmou en tē erēmō
verses.literal: [do] not harden your - hearts as [you did] in the rebellion in the day - of testing in the wilderness

verses.original: οὗ ὑμῶν οἱ πατέρες ἐπείρασαν ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ καὶ τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη εἶδον μου τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: hou hymōn hoi pateres epeirasan en dokimasia kai tesserakonta etē eidon mou ta erga
verses.literal: where your - fathers tested [and] tried [Me] and for forty years saw My - works

verses.original: διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ ταύτῃ γενεᾷ καὶ εἶπον τῇ αὐτοὶ καρδίᾳ Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν μου τὰς ὁδούς
verses.transliteration: dio prosōchthisa tē tautē genea kai eipon tē autoi kardia Aei planōntai de ouk egnōsan mou tas hodous
verses.literal: Therefore I was angry with that generation and I said - Their hearts {are} always going astray and vvv they have not known My - ways

verses.original: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν μου τῇ ὀργῇ Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς μου τὴν κατάπαυσίν
verses.transliteration: hōs ōmosa en mou tē orgē Ei eiseleusontai eis mou tēn katapausin
verses.literal: So I swore on oath in My - anger vvv They shall never enter . . . My - rest

verses.original: Βλέπετε ἀδελφοί ποτε μή‿ τινι ἔν ὑμῶν ἔσται πονηρὰ καρδία ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ ζῶντος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Blepete adelphoi pote mē tini en hymōn estai ponēra kardia apistias en tō apostēnai apo zōntos Theou
verses.literal: See to it brothers [that] vvv [none] - of you has a wicked heart of unbelief vvv vvv that turns away from [the] living God

verses.original: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθ’ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν ἄχρις οὗ καλεῖται τὸ Σήμερον ἵνα μὴ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν σκληρυνθῇ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἀπάτῃ
verses.transliteration: alla parakaleite heautous kath’ hekastēn hēmeran achris hou kaleitai to Sēmeron hina mē tis ex hymōn sklērynthē tēs hamartias apatē
verses.literal: But exhort one another . . . vvv daily as long as - it is called - today so that vvv none of you may be hardened - by sin’s deceitfulness

verses.original: γὰρ γεγόναμεν Μέτοχοι τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐάνπερ κατάσχωμεν βεβαίαν μέχρι τέλους τῆς ὑποστάσεως τὴν ἀρχὴν
verses.transliteration: gar gegonamen Metochoi tou Christou eanper kataschōmen bebaian mechri telous tēs hypostaseōs tēn archēn
verses.literal: - We have come to share - in Christ if we hold firmly to [the] end the assurance - [we had] at first

verses.original: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι Σήμερον ἐὰν ἀκούσητε αὐτοῦ τῆς φωνῆς Μὴ σκληρύνητε ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ
verses.transliteration: en tō legesthai Sēmeron ean akousēte autou tēs phōnēs Mē sklērynēte hymōn tas kardias hōs en tō parapikrasmō
verses.literal: As - it has been said Today if you hear His - voice {do} not harden your - hearts as [you did] in the rebellion

verses.original: γὰρ Τίνες ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντες οἱ Μωϋσέως διὰ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου
verses.transliteration: gar Tines akousantes parepikranan all’ ou pantes hoi Mōuseōs dia exelthontes ex Aigyptou
verses.literal: For who were the ones who heard [and] rebelled - [Were they] not all those Moses led - out of Egypt

verses.original: δὲ τίσιν προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: de tisin prosōchthisen tesserakonta etē ouchi tois hamartēsasin hōn ta kōla epesen en tē erēmō
verses.literal: And with whom was [God] angry for forty years [Was it] not with those who sinned whose - bodies fell in the wilderness

verses.original: δὲ τίσιν ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν κατάπαυσιν εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν
verses.transliteration: de tisin ōmosen mē eiseleusesthai eis autou tēn katapausin ei mē tois apeithēsasin
verses.literal: And to whom did He swear [that they] vvv would never enter . . . His - rest [Was it] not to those who disobeyed

verses.original: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι δι’ ἀπιστίαν οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai blepomen hoti di’ apistian ouk ēdynēthēsan eiselthein
verses.literal: [So] we see that [it was] because of [their] unbelief vvv that they were unable to enter
